title: Falling blocks
tagline: Stack falling shapes into perfect lines.
teaser: Shapes fall. Turn them, slide them, complete lines and keep the stack low as the pace builds.

manPage.synopsis: blocks — rotate and place falling pieces; clear full lines.
manPage.description: Chris Torek and Darren F. Provine wrote the BSD version, reworking an entry that won the 1989 International Obfuscated C Code Contest. Hubert Feyrer added a preview of the next piece in 1999.

howToPlay: Shapes fall from the top, one at a time.
Turn and slide them to fill complete lines.
Full lines clear; keep the stack from reaching the top.
